blocks.text: All organisms have requirements for life, which they meet by interacting with other organisms and with the physical environment. Ecology is the study of the relationships of organisms with other organisms and with the environment. This chapter covers the basic concepts of the environment and the cycling of materials and energy between the environment and organisms.
To understand how life works, we look at the levels on which the natural world is organised, layers of increasing complexity.
